analysis.jiraIssueSummary: 4. FE - Catalog Import - Spectacle Lens Add-Ons Product Category and Filters (Category, Add-On Name)
requirementOrBugAnalysis: Story scope is FE behavior in Settings > Ordering > Catalog Import to support a new Product Category option: Spectacle Lens - Add-Ons.
Product category availability is constrained by organization type: Spectacle Lens category is for non-PV organizations; catalog import is not available for PV organizations across categories.
Spectacle Lens and Spectacle Lens Add-Ons are separate data structures and must be searched/imported separately.
When Spectacle Lens - Add-Ons is selected, add-on-specific filters must be shown.
Specified filters for this category are Supplier, Category, and Add-On Name.

Supplier filter is defined in base description as searchable single-select DDM with infinite scroll, default value All, alphabetical sorting for supplier names, and sourcing from active loaded electronic supplier locations; includes behavior when no suppliers are loaded (All only).
Comment discussion introduces conflict about Supplier possibly being multi-select; latest comment says unresolved and asks for decision, so final requirement is not confirmed.
Category filter is multi-select DDM with infinite scroll and values Coatings, Finishing, Other, Surfacing, Tints sorted alphabetically.
Add-On Name filter is searchable text field supporting alphanumeric and special characters with max 200 characters and no minimum characters.
Comment indicates typeahead suggestions should appear under search input beginning at 1 character, but search results table is populated only when Search button is clicked.

Multi-select behavior requirements apply to multi-select filters: selected values persist, dropdown stays open during selection, closes only on outside click, single internal x clears all selections, individual removal done by deselecting in dropdown, and deselecting one does not clear others.
Applied filters are shown as text list inside search bar field and truncated with ellipsis when too long.

Actions: Search executes using current search value + selected filters and populates Search Results; selected criteria remain after Search. Clear Filters resets search bar, all filters, and Search Results table.
missingInformation: Final confirmed selection mode for Supplier filter (single-select vs multi-select) is not resolved in comments.
Exact label/placement distinction between global search bar ('Search add-ons') and Add-On Name filter is unclear after comment requesting removal of dual search.
Exact source API contract and response behavior for typeahead dropdown suggestions is not provided.
Behavior when no results are returned (empty state message, table state) is not specified.
Case sensitivity/accent sensitivity rules for Add-On Name search and typeahead matching are not specified.
Trim/whitespace handling rules for Add-On Name input are not specified.
Whether Add-On Name field is mandatory for search execution is not specified.
Whether Supplier filter supports selecting All together with other supplier values (if multi-select) is not specified.
Pagination/sorting behavior in Search Results after this filter set is not specified in this story.
No explicit acceptance criteria for keyboard accessibility of dropdown/typeahead interactions.
ambiguities: Description says Add-On Name has no minimum characters, while comment states one character to start dropdown suggestions.
Description lists both category and add-on name search fields; comment suggests removing dual search and relying on Add-On Name/Supplier/Category filters.
Supplier selection behavior is contradictory: documented single-select vs open debate on multi-select in review comment.
Applied filter display is stated as inside search bar field, but if dual search is removed, target UI element for applied list is unclear.
Supplier dependency text references loaded eyeglasses supplier locations; applicability for add-ons may be inferred but not explicitly restated.
risks: Incorrect org gating could expose catalog import to PV organizations or hide it from eligible non-PV organizations.
Supplier filter implementation mismatch (single vs multi) can break expected backend query behavior and user workflows.
Typeahead triggering and Search button execution may conflict, causing premature table updates or stale results.
Large supplier lists with infinite scroll may cause performance issues, duplicate entries, or ordering defects.
Clear Filters may fail to reset results table or hidden stateful controls, leading to false user assumptions.
Ellipsis truncation for applied filters may hide critical selection context and create usability issues.
Special-character handling in Add-On Name may cause escaping issues or failed queries.
dependencies: GEM-35731 (BE product category and filters support) for API/data support of add-ons filtering.
GEM-35732 (BE search results/selection/add flow) for search execution and returned dataset behavior.
GEM-37159 (FE search results, selection, add confirmation, toast) for end-to-end flow continuity after filters/search.
Supplier/location master data availability and active/loaded electronic supplier location flags.
Existing shared UI behavior patterns referenced from Frames filters and Spectacle Lens searchable dropdown components.
clarificationQuestions: Please confirm final Supplier filter behavior: single-select or multi-select?
If Supplier is multi-select, can All be selected together with specific suppliers, or is it mutually exclusive?
Is the separate 'Search add-ons' bar still required, or should Add-On Name be the only text search input?
If both search bar and Add-On Name remain, how do they interact when both contain values (AND/OR precedence)?
Should typeahead suggestions appear for Add-On Name only, search bar only, or both?
Please confirm minimum characters: 0 for manual search execution, and 1 for suggestion dropdown triggering?
What exact behavior is expected when Search is clicked with all filters blank/default?
What empty-state text/UI is expected when search returns no results?
Should Add-On Name matching be case-insensitive and trim leading/trailing spaces?
Is there a required debounce timing or max number of suggestions for typeahead dropdown?
recommendedTestScenarios: Validate product category visibility and access gating for PV vs non-PV organizations.
Validate Spectacle Lens - Add-Ons selection renders correct add-on-specific filter set.
Validate Supplier filter defaults, ordering, source constraints, and no-loaded-supplier fallback.
Validate Category multi-select values, sort order, and multi-select interaction behavior.
Validate Add-On Name input constraints (0..200, special chars) and suggestion trigger behavior.
Validate Search action uses current filter state and preserves selected values post-search.
Validate Clear Filters resets search input, all filters, and results table state.
Validate applied filter display and ellipsis truncation behavior for long selections.
Validate negative and boundary scenarios: max length, special characters, empty selections, no results.
Validate integration with BE stories for accurate result retrieval per supplier/category/name combinations.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that Spectacle Lens - Add-Ons category is available only for eligible organizations
preconditions: Have one non-PV test org and one PV test org
User has access to Settings > Ordering > Catalog Import

steps.action: Login with non-PV org user and open Catalog Import product category dropdown
steps.expected: Spectacle Lens - Add-Ons option is visible and selectable

steps.action: Login with PV org user and navigate to Catalog Import
steps.expected: Catalog Import is not available (or inaccessible) per org rule

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that selecting Spectacle Lens - Add-Ons displays add-on-specific filters
preconditions: Non-PV org user is on Catalog Import page

steps.action: Select Product Category = Spectacle Lens - Add-Ons
steps.expected: Filter panel shows Supplier, Category, and Add-On Name fields relevant to add-ons

steps.action: Observe filters specific to other categories
steps.expected: Non-applicable category-specific fields are not shown

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that Supplier filter shows default All and alphabetical supplier options
preconditions: Eligible org with loaded active electronic supplier locations

steps.action: Open Supplier dropdown after selecting Spectacle Lens - Add-Ons
steps.expected: All is first and selected by default

steps.action: Inspect supplier list ordering
steps.expected: Supplier names are sorted alphabetically A-Z

steps.action: Use search in Supplier dropdown
steps.expected: List is searchable and results filter accordingly

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that Supplier filter falls back to only All when no suppliers are loaded
preconditions: Eligible org with no loaded suppliers

steps.action: Open Supplier dropdown
steps.expected: Only All is available and selected

steps.action: Run Search with default filters
steps.expected: Search executes without supplier-specific selection errors

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that Category filter supports configured multi-select behavior

steps.action: Open Category dropdown
steps.expected: Values include Coatings, Finishing, Other, Surfacing, Tints in alphabetical order

steps.action: Select multiple category values
steps.expected: Dropdown remains open and selected values remain visible in field

steps.action: Click outside dropdown
steps.expected: Dropdown closes and selections persist

steps.action: Click the single x inside Category field
steps.expected: All selected category values are cleared

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that Add-On Name accepts valid input boundaries and special characters

steps.action: Enter 200-character mixed alphanumeric/special-character value in Add-On Name
steps.expected: Input is accepted without validation error

steps.action: Enter 201-character value
steps.expected: Input is blocked at 200 characters or validation clearly prevents submission beyond 200

steps.action: Leave Add-On Name blank and click Search
steps.expected: Search executes using other/default filters (if allowed) without mandatory-field error

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that Search action populates results and preserves entered criteria
preconditions: At least one known matching dataset exists

steps.action: Set Supplier/Category/Add-On Name filters with known matching criteria and click Search
steps.expected: Search Results table populates with matching add-on records

steps.action: Inspect filter values after results load
steps.expected: All selected/entered filter values remain visible and unchanged

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that Clear Filters resets fields and clears search results
preconditions: A prior search has been executed and results are visible

steps.action: Click Clear Filters
steps.expected: Search bar/input is reset, Supplier/Category/Add-On Name return to default/blank states

steps.action: Observe Search Results table
steps.expected: Results table is cleared/reset as specified

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that applied filter text is displayed and truncated with ellipsis when too long
preconditions: Multiple filter values selected to create long applied-filter text

steps.action: Apply long combined filter selections and run Search if required to display applied filters
steps.expected: Applied filters appear as text list in designated field

steps.action: Check display when text exceeds available width
steps.expected: Text is truncated with ellipsis rather than overflowing or wrapping incorrectly

regressionConsiderations: Existing Catalog Import behavior for other product categories remains unchanged.
Frames multi-select filter interaction pattern remains consistent and unaffected.
Spectacle Lens existing searchable dropdown behavior in ordering flow is not regressed by shared component updates.
Search/Clear actions continue to work consistently across categories after introducing add-ons category.
No regression in supplier data loading/infinite scroll performance for large organizations.
